overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete billing periods, each built on a time period.
intro: A billing period is a settings record built on a time period, with a name, a period and a duration. You can list, create, read, update and delete billing periods. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **A create takes the time period's hyphenated uuid, not its `tp_` id.** For a time period `tp_580762f904bd2bd26d3d7e71ae87aa72`, send `580762f9-04bd-2bd2-6d3d-7e71ae87aa72` as `time_period`. Charging and pricing periods take the `tp_` id instead.
**`name` and `time_period` are required on a create.** Both go under the `billing_period` key.
**An update returns `time_period` in place of `period` and `duration`.** Read the billing period again to see those two fields.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.
**A delete returns `204` with no body.** Reading the billing period afterwards returns `404`.

endpoints.title: List billing periods
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of billing periods under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the billing periods on the instance. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of billing periods, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create a billing period
endpoints.summary: Creates a billing period and returns it under `billing_period`.
endpoints.description: Send the new billing period under `billing_period`. `name` and `time_period` are required. `time_period` is the time period's hyphenated uuid, not its `tp_` id: put dashes back into the 32 characters after `tp_` in an 8, 4, 4, 4, 12 pattern.

time_period.description: The time period's hyphenated uuid, not its `tp_` id.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a billing period
endpoints.summary: Returns one billing period by its `id`, under `billing_period`.
endpoints.description: Reads the billing period with this `bp_` `id`.

parameters.name: billing_period_id
parameters.description: The billing period's `bp_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete a billing period
endpoints.summary: Deletes a billing period. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the billing period with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: billing_period_id
parameters.description: The billing period's `bp_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The billing period is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Update a billing period
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on a billing period and returns it under `billing_period`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `billing_period`. The response carries `time_period` in place of `period` and `duration`, so read the billing period again to see those fields.

parameters.name: billing_period_id
parameters.description: The billing period's `bp_` `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
